description: Get EU/international legal basis for a specific provision or document within a South African statute. If provision_ref is provided, returns article-level references. If omitted, returns all international references for the entire document. Example: POPIA -> references GDPR. Cybercrimes Act -> references Budapest Convention.

provision_ref.description: Optional provision reference (e.g., "s2", "s2(1)"). If omitted, returns document-level references.

name: get_provision_eu_basis
